title: fix(runtime,cli): the dispatcher /meta refusal applies the errors.permission_denied override; install's token conflict names env credentials

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:三项复核跟进。① runtime 调度器那一侧的 `/meta` 读门,在拒绝无权打开的应用、仪表盘、列表视图时,也读部署自定义的 `errors.permission_denied` 文案(此前只有 REST 一侧读);② `os package install` 同时给了 `--token` 和邮箱密码时的拒绝句,写明 `OS_RUNTIME_EMAIL`/`OS_RUNTIME_PASSWORD` 也算 `--email`/`--password`;③ ui 三处注释和 README 里的旧拒绝句、旧 `-r` 参数改为现行写法。
- 为什么改:PR #30792 合约评审 6676098596 的 should-fix 三项。同一个用户走两个入口,看到的拒绝文案应一致;用户只在 shell 里 export 过邮箱变量时,看不出为什么带 `--token` 被拒。
- 风险与回滚:低。① 只多读一个可选服务,i18n 服务缺席、解析失败或 `t` 抛错都回落到内置句,仍是 403 不是 500;② 只改一句文案;③ 只改注释与 README,无 ui 行为变化。回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts` 的 `metaItemReadGateSources` 新增的 `resolveMessageTranslator`;`packages/cli/src/commands/package/install.ts` 的拒绝句。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/meta-permission-refusal-override.test.ts`(12 条全绿)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

1. **`@objectstack/runtime`.** `metaItemReadGateSources` (the `HttpDispatcher` side of the shared `/meta` read gate) now hands `resolveMessageTranslator`: the request's `i18n` service `t`, as `RestServer.resolveMessageTranslator` hands it. A deployment's `errors.permission_denied` override therefore reads the same on both doors for the app, dashboard and list-view refusals. An `i18n` service that cannot be resolved answers `undefined`; a `t` that throws is already caught by `renderOperationMessage`. Either way the caller gets the built-in catalog sentence and a 403.
2. **`@objectstack/cli`.** The `os package install` token-conflict refusal now reads: `Pass either --token or --email/--password, not both (OS_RUNTIME_TOKEN counts as --token; OS_RUNTIME_EMAIL/OS_RUNTIME_PASSWORD count as --email/--password).`
3. **ui prose, comments and README only.** `MarketplacePackagePage.offlineLocalMenu-11627.test.tsx:84` doc comment `-r` → `-u`; `ui/packages/data-objectstack/README.md:913` and the `MetaItemAccess.message` doc comment in `src/index.ts` quote the catalog's current English sentence. No ui behaviour change.

Changeset: patch for `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/cli` and `@object-ui/data-objectstack` (its README ships in `files[]`).

## Tests

- New `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-permission-refusal-override.test.ts`, through `dispatch()`, on all three refusals (app, dashboard, list view), caller locale `zh-CN`: the override is the message and `t` is asked `errors.permission_denied` in `zh-CN`; CONTROL with no i18n service gives the built-in zh-CN sentence; an unresolvable i18n service and a throwing `t` give the built-in sentence and the 403.
- `packages/cli/test/package-install-url-token-flags.test.ts`: a new case exports `OS_RUNTIME_EMAIL`/`OS_RUNTIME_PASSWORD`, passes only `--token`, and pins the full refusal sentence, exit 1 and no request sent.
- Red first: with both fixes reverted to `origin/main` (tests at HEAD), 3 of 12 runtime cases (the three override cases) and 1 of 9 CLI cases fail; with the fix, 12/12 and 9/9 pass.

## Acceptance notes

- The ui test fixtures that still mock the old by-name sentence as a server answer (`appAccessProbe.test.ts`, `metaItemAccessProbe-12112.test.ts`, two studio-design `draftUnreadable-29148` tests) are left alone: they are stand-in server answers, not prose, and the card scopes item 3 to the three residues it names.
